additionalFields.test-objective: Verify system rejects invalid email formats and displays appropriate error message.
preconditions: User is logged into the CRM system.
User navigates to the contact creation screen.
test-steps: Enter valid data in Name, Phone Number, Company, and Position fields.
Enter an invalid email format (e.g., 'invalidemail.com') in the Email field.
additionalFields.expected-result: System displays an error message indicating the email format is invalid.
additionalFields.post-conditions: No contact is saved in the CRM system.

uiText.invalidEmailError: Please enter a valid email address.
